::: {#rem-vanishing-remedies}

#### What keeps gradients from vanishing

The [ReLU](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-relu) removes the $\frac{1}{4}$ bound on each layer's slopes.
Other remedies are
starting the weights at a scale that keeps the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient)'s size steady from layer to layer,
such as [He initialization](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#def-he-initialization) or [Glorot initialization](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#def-glorot-initialization),
normalizing each layer's values,
and [residual connections](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#def-residual-connection), which give the gradient a path around each layer.
[lds's experiment on depth](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#sec-vanishing-experiment) measures the same effect.

:::
